claim: Typing ZZLONGROW returns two work-order rows whose primary line is cut short with an ellipsis. The line holds 622px of text and paints 459px; the hidden tail is " Heavy Haulage And Trailer Repair Services Of Greater Fernvale 123786".

instrument.positive_control: The same reader reports clipped=false on the short rows S2-34360 and S2-34157 in the Fernvale search, in the same session with the same code path. So clipped=true is a property of these rows, not a constant the reader always returns.
instrument.independent_repeat: Varied the suspected cause rather than replaying the input: measured at four viewport widths (1280/1440/1920/2560) in separate panel openings, and confirmed a second way with a rendered screenshot instead of a geometry read. All five agree.
instrument.state_recorded: Admin on app.staging.shopview.com, build v26.39.1-97cad2c, 29 Sep 2026. Viewport 1440x900; the search modal is a FIXED 640px panel and the primary-line box is 459px wide at every viewport tried. Pointer moved to 0,0 and read back with document.elementFromPoint before each read, and again after the tab switch re-laid the panel. Each query typed fresh into an emptied box; the Work orders tab opened deliberately because the All tab lists only five rows per group.
instrument.what_would_make_this_my_fault: That the clip is my headless window being narrower than a real user's screen. Ruled out by measuring at 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2560: the modal stays 640px and the title box stays 459px of a 622px value at all four, because the panel is fixed-width. Also ruled out by a second, independent instrument - a screenshot of the rendered row shows the ellipsis painted on screen, which agrees with the geometry read. Computed style on the element is overflow:hidden, text-overflow:ellipsis, white-space:nowrap.

note: No new ticket is proposed: SV-10619 ('Some search results show "...." for the match instead of the full match') is Open and is this exact defect. SV-10551 is its sibling on unit number.
